digest.component_or_area: store epoch guard (sync and push union sites)
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching sync._union_merge must return without merging and preserve both local and remote refs unchanged.
A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching push.py non-fast-forward retry must abort the retry loop immediately via return, perform zero merges and zero re-pushes, and leave both refs unchanged.

The epoch guard must distinguish between remote ref unreadable (git show non-zero due to ref failure) and remote file absent (git show non-zero due to missing file), emitting different log messages for each case.

The complete state matrix of local/remote record and epoch presence/absence combinations must be implemented, including record-absent vs epoch-absent distinctions and corrupt-record handling per spec, with zero silent absences.

write_compat_record must preserve an existing valid string epoch value, never generate a new epoch, and treat non-string epoch as corrupt; an older binary must not error or fail closed when reading a record carrying epoch.
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING) and both local and remote commit tips must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
